family_summary: Compared with the original pages, AI-built pages generally simplify markup into leaner DOM with fewer classes, reorganize headings into clear h1–h4 hierarchies, consolidate or introduce semantic landmarks, strip rich social and JSON-LD metadata down to minimal meta tags (sometimes rewriting titles), mostly replace missing or poor alt text with descriptive alts, and (in the one site observed) keep call-to-action controls as styled anchors while adding an off-screen skip-to-content link.
